The earliest possible performance of Shakespeare’s *The Taming of the Shrew* was on June 11, 1594, at Newington Butts Theatre. The diary that records it calls the play *The Taming of a Shrew*, so it’s unclear whether it was Shakespeare’s version. (shaxdoc.titania.folger.edu)
The earliest confirmed performance of Shakespeare’s version was on November 26, 1633, at St. James’s Palace before King Charles I and Queen Henrietta Maria. (cambridge.org)
